rules.detects: a type carrying @main, which the system starts: a SwiftUI App, a UIApplicationDelegate, or a command-line entry
a type conforming to AppIntent (Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight and the Action button run its perform), or to AppShortcutsProvider
the class an extension's Info.plist or XcodeGen project.yml names as NSExtensionPrincipalClass, which the host app loads
a main.swift, whose top-level code runs when its executable target starts

entrances.notDetected: scene and app delegates set up in code, URL-scheme and universal-link handlers, background tasks, notification handlers, widget timelines and watch complications are not detected

ci.note: The Swift plugin grades through sourcekit-lsp, which ships with the Swift toolchain: a macOS runner with Xcode, or a Linux runner with the toolchain installed. References come from the SwiftPM index, so a package must build once before the check sees its references.

ladder.because: the Swift compiler refuses a reference to a private or fileprivate declaration from outside its file (private: its enclosing scope and extensions in the same file), and to an internal one from outside its module; a public or open declaration is reachable from any module that imports it

rungs.fact: the protected declaration is private or fileprivate, so the compiler refuses any reference from another file, and every reference in its own file is inside the chokepoint

rungs.enforcer: Coherence's check at the edit and in CI
rungs.fact: the declaration is internal, package, public or open and reachable from other files; every reference sourcekit-lsp reports in the project is inside the chokepoint
